description: Appraisal rubric for the systematic-review skill. Each item is matched sentence by sentence against full-text paragraphs first, then title/abstract; the first matching sentence is quoted with its locator. The outcome_measure item keeps only generic measurement cues here: the skill adds outcome terms collected from the supplied records and materials at run time, so no domain word list is hard-coded. This file is optional: if it is missing or unreadable, scripts/run_skill.py falls back to identical built-in defaults.
